title: Avoid mutating `req.headers` when stripping internal headers

target.summary: Copying the request headers before sealing detaches the userland headers() view from the underlying request. Subsequent mutations to request headers (e.g., from a proxy or middleware) will not be reflected when reading headers(), returning stale values.
notes: faulty statement copying headers before sealing, which detaches headers() from the request
